blocks.text: Structural biology mein macromolecules (bare molecules, jaise proteins aur nucleic acids) ki three dimensional (3D, teen rukh wali) structure ko atomic level par parha jata hai. Is se kisi biomolecule ki structure, us ke kaam (functions), us ki harkat (dynamics), aur ligands (us se judne wale chhote molecules) aur doosre macromolecules ke saath us ke rabte (interaction) ki poori maloomat milti hai.
Structural biology ke bohat se faide (applications) hain, khaas kar medical research mein. In mein se kuch yeh hain:
1- Active sites aur domains maloom karna

Structural biologists proteins aur nucleic acids jaise macromolecules ki 3D structure maloom kar sakte hain. Is 3D structure se pata chalta hai ke active site aur alag alag domains kahan hain, un ki shakal kaisi hai aur un ke aas paas kya hai. Domain molecule ka woh alag hissa hai jo apna kaam khud karta hai. Misal: enzyme HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ki structure se us ke do domains pehchane gaye: polymerase domain (jo DNA banata hai) aur RNase H domain (jo RNA-DNA hybrid mein se RNA wali strand ko tod deta hai). In domains ki jagah aur shakal jaan kar aisi antiviral dawaein banai gayin jo seedha inhi ko nishana banati hain. Isi tarah serine proteases ki structure se un ki wazeh active site dikhti hai, jo peptide bonds todti hai.

blocks.alt: Proteins ki do satahi (surface) tasaweer. (a) HIV-1 reverse transcriptase: bara gehra neela jism jis par halke hare lobes hain aur us ke paar nucleic acid ka double helix para hai; ek gher kiya lobe Polymerase domain aur doosra Nuclease domain hai. (b) Serine protease: surmai (grey) gol satah jis par chhoti neeli-surkh jeb ghair kar Active site likhi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: (a) HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ki 3D banawat; (b) serine protease ki 3D banawat (kitab ki Figure 7.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Domain protein ka woh hissa hai jo apna alag kaam karta hai. HIV ke reverse transcriptase mein polymerase domain DNA banata hai aur nuclease (RNase H) domain RNA ko kaat-ta hai; dawaein inhi jagahon ko nishana banati hain. Serine protease mein active site woh chhoti jeb (pocket) hai jahan substrate judta hai.

Structural biology scientists ko beemari paida karne wale molecule par woh sahi jagah dhoondne mein madad deti hai jahan dawa kaam kar sake. Yeh jagahein aam tor par proteins hoti hain aur inhen drug targets kehte hain. In proteins ki 3D shakal dekh kar scientists woh khaas jagahein dhoondte hain jahan dawa jud kar protein ka kaam rok de. Misal: COVID-19 mein scientists ne coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) ke spike protein ko structural biology se parha. Yahi protein virus ko insani cells mein dakhil hone mein madad deta hai. Is ki 3D structure jaan kar scientists ne ise drug target mana, aur aisi vaccines aur dawaein banayin jo spike protein ko rok deti hain, taake virus mazeed cells ko infect na kar sake.

Structural biology yeh samajhne mein bhi madad deti hai ke pathogens (beemari phailane wale, jaise viruses ya bacteria) host (jis ke jism mein woh aate hain) ke cells ke saath kaise milte hain. Ise host–pathogen interaction kehte hain. Pathogen aur host cell dono ke proteins ki 3D structure dekh kar scientists jaan lete hain ke pathogen host cell se kaise chipakta aur andar jata hai, aur is mein kaun se molecules shamil hain. Misal: scientists ne coronavirus ka spike protein parha jo virus ki satah (surface) se bahar nikla hota hai. Unhon ne insani cells ka woh protein bhi dekha jo spike protein ka receptor (pakadne wala) hai. Is tarah pata chala ke virus insani cells mein bilkul kaise dakhil hota hai. Yeh maloomat aisi dawaein banane mein bohat kaam aayi jo receptor proteins se jud jati hain. Aisi dawa virus ko receptor se milne nahi deti, is liye virus host cells mein dakhil nahi ho pata.

blocks.alt: Insani cell ki satah (neeli) jis par do hare Y-numa ACE2 receptors hain. Upar ek gol SARS-CoV-2 zarra jis par spike proteins hain, ek ACE2 se jura hai (SARS-CoV-2 spike protein binding to ACE2). Neeche daen doosra virus membrane ki jeb mein cell ke andar le jaya ja raha hai (Viral entry, replication, and ACE2 normal function blocked).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: Corona virus ka insani cell ke receptor se jurne ka tareeqa (kitab ki Figure 7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Virus ke kaante (spike proteins) cell ki satah ke ACE2 receptor mein chabi ki tarah fit hote hain. Judne ke baad virus cell mein dakhil ho kar apni copies banata hai aur ACE2 apna aam kaam nahi kar pata. Structural biology se yeh jodh dekh kar aisi dawa ya vaccine banai ja sakti hai jo spike aur ACE2 ka milna rok de.

Protein tabhi theek kaam karta hai jab woh sahi tarah 3D shakal mein fold ho (mud kar apni shakal banaye). Kai beemariyan, jaise cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s aur Alzheimer’s, proteins ki ghalat folding se hoti hain. Structural biology se samajh aata hai ke folding ke pecheeda raste kya hain aur ghalat folding beemari tak kaise le jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne beemariyon ke naam ghalat spelling se chhape hain: “cyctic fibrosis”, “Parkinsons” aur “Alziemer’s”. Sahi naam cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s disease aur Alzheimer’s disease hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek naya virus saamne aata hai. Beemari rokne ke liye structural biologist upar ke chaar faide kis tarteeb se istemal karega?
blocks.explanation: Pehle virus ki satah wale protein ki 3D structure nikal kar us ke domains aur active sites dhoondega. Phir in mein se drug target chunega. Phir woh insani receptor parhega jis se virus judta hai (host–pathogen interaction), taake aisi dawa ya vaccine bane jo virus ka andar jana rok de. Protein misfolding ka mutala yahan kam zaroori hai, magar un host proteins ke liye kaam aata hai jinhen virus kharab kar de.

items: Structural biology proteins aur nucleic acids ki 3D structure atomic level par parhti hai: structure, kaam, harkat aur doosre molecules se rabta.

Chaar faide: active sites aur domains (HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, serine proteases); drug targets (SARS-CoV-2 spike); host–pathogen interaction (spike aur receptor); protein misfolding wali beemariyan (cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s).
